fact: Formal South Africa-to-SADC remittance outflows rose from about R6 billion in 2016 to over R19 billion in 2024, with Zimbabwe, Lesotho, Malawi and Mozambique about 90% of the total, and the weighted cost of a USD200 transfer in the CMA rose from 2.9% in 2021 to 6.5% in 2024.
title: South Africa to the rest of SADC Remittances Market Assessment 2024 Report
publisher: FinMark Trust, supported by the South African Reserve Bank
